newsitem.title: MALTA: Hotel seeks stock exchange listing in Malta.
newsitem.headline: Hotel seeks stock exchange listing in Malta.

text.p: One of Malta's biggest four-star hotels is negotiating to be listed on the local stock exchange, an hotel official said on Wednesday.
Suncrest Hotel will soon be issuing "investment instruments for subscription by the public," said Angelo Xuereb, chairman of the holding company, AX Holdings.

"The securities will be pitched at an attractive level of return and should provide the investing public with an opportunity to participate in this sector and of diversifying its investments portfolio," he said.
The Suncrest is a four-star 434-room hotel in Qawra, one of Malta's most popular holiday resorts, some 10 miles north of Valletta. Its clients are mostly British.

The listing of the hotel's securities would be a first from the tourism industry for the stock exchange. Set up in early 1992, the exchange has five listed companies -- Mid-Med Bank, Bank of Valletta, Lombard Bank, Middle Sea Insurance and soft-drinks maker Simonds Farsons Clark.
